phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic close-up of the Speaking Angel entity. The dark obsidian skin is semi-transparent, revealing a complex network of amber plasma circuitry glowing deep within. The figure is gesturing slightly with a glass hand, pointing towards a blurred background of geometric sky structures. The atmosphere is thick and cinematic, with particles of dust floating in the high-contrast light. The focus is sharp on the texture of the glass shoulder and neck, blurring out the background.
